implementation: Offline common 99-YP capacity, progressive refill over one complete source roar animation; 1 YP/second decay slowed by source retention percent. SP is separate: 1000 start/2000 cap, +100 per personal kill, 100 per nonstarter weapon in selected loadout or nondefault mutation. Standard loadout free. These shared numerical rules are explicit mobile tuning; original variant caps, SP rewards/costs and decay constants are not fully decoded.
